title: Fabrication of antibacterial silver nanoparticle-loaded PVA/chitosan microfibers via forcespinning for wastewater disinfection
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22687-22697
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01428C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vu Viet Linh Nguyen, H. Long Nguyen, Duc-Quang Hoang, Dai Phu Huynh
Antibacterial forcespun Ag-PVA/CS microfibers (∼1.74 µm) achieved up to 95.4% (E. coli) and 93.1% (coliform) bacterial removal from real wastewater samples within 60 min, offering a sustainable and high-throughput solution for water purification.
